overview: Iteration 4: Enhance the AI Waiter chatbot. Connect to Rainbow AI (hosted on AWS Lightsail at C:\Users\Jyue\Documents\1-projects\Software Projects\rainbow-ai) as an intelligent backend, and add customer-facing UX improvements: time-aware suggestions, quick-reply buttons, food photo cards, feedback mechanism, and chat analytics dashboard.
goals: Set up proper Makan Moments profile in Rainbow AI with cafe-specific KB, system prompt, and routing
Add a knowledge-context API endpoint to Rainbow AI so external apps can fetch compiled KB
Wire fnb-online-ordering system prompt to Rainbow AI KB with graceful fallback
Add time-aware proactive menu suggestions based on time-of-day
Add suggested quick-reply buttons for common customer queries
Add inline food photo cards when AI mentions menu items
Add thumbs up/down feedback on AI responses
Add conversation logging from fnb to Rainbow AI
Add Chat Analytics tab to admin dashboard

userStories.title: Populate Makan Moments KB and config in Rainbow AI
userStories.description: The makan-moments profile exists in Rainbow AI but has placeholder content. Populate .rainbow-kb-makan/ with proper cafe knowledge, fix the profile's kbDir to use a relative path (works on both Windows dev and Linux Lightsail), and update data-makan/settings.json with a cafe-specific system prompt instead of the hostel one.
acceptanceCriteria: profiles.json kbDir for makan-moments changed from absolute Windows path to relative '.rainbow-kb-makan'

.rainbow-kb-makan/cafe-facts.md contains full cafe info: name (Makan Moments Cafe / 食光记忆 / Kafe Kenangan Makan), address (Taman Impian Emas, Skudai, Johor), hours (10am-9pm daily, last order 8:30pm), cuisine (Thai-Malaysian fusion), dietary (NO PORK, NO LARD, Halal-friendly), WiFi, payment methods, social media
.rainbow-kb-makan/faq.md contains at least 10 real FAQs: halal, parking, reservation, delivery, WiFi, best sellers, payment, kids menu, takeaway, catering
.rainbow-kb-makan/ordering.md explains the pre-order flow: browse menu → add to tray → provide phone + arrival time → admin approves → customer pays T&G deposit → food prepared
data-makan/settings.json system_prompt updated to cafe AI waiter identity (not hostel Rainbow identity)
data-makan/settings.json staff phones removed or updated to cafe staff
soul.md updated with specific cafe personality traits: food-enthusiastic, proactive seller, multilingual (EN/MS/ZH)
technicalNotes: Rainbow AI project is at: C:\Users\Jyue\Documents\1-projects\Software Projects\rainbow-ai
Read the existing files first: profiles.json, .rainbow-kb-makan/soul.md, .rainbow-kb-makan/faq.md, data-makan/settings.json
Copy detailed knowledge from fnb-online-ordering/knowledge/cafe-facts.md and knowledge/faq.md — these are the source of truth
Keep the AGENTS.md in .rainbow-kb-makan/ as-is (it's the routing instructions for Rainbow)
The system_prompt in settings.json should NOT include menu items (those come from the KB dynamically)
For kbDir: use '.rainbow-kb-makan' (relative, no trailing slash)

userStories.title: Add KB content API endpoint to Rainbow AI
userStories.description: Add a GET /api/chat/:profileId/kb-context endpoint to Rainbow AI's webchat router that returns the compiled system prompt with all relevant KB content injected. This allows external apps (like fnb-online-ordering) to fetch Rainbow AI's knowledge base context without duplicating KB files.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/chat/:profileId/kb-context returns JSON { systemPrompt: string, kbFiles: string[], cachedAt: number }
systemPrompt contains the profile's base system_prompt from settings.json with all KB markdown files concatenated
kbFiles lists the filenames that were injected into the prompt
Response is cached in memory with 5-minute TTL, invalidated when KB files change
Returns 404 if profileId doesn't match any registered profile
Rate limited (same as webchat: 10/min per IP)
No auth required (public endpoint, KB content is not sensitive)
technicalNotes: Edit: C:\Users\Jyue\Documents\1-projects\Software Projects\rainbow-ai\src\routes\public\webchat-api.ts
Use the existing profile registry: profileRegistry.getProfile(profileId)
Use kb.getKnowledgeMarkdown() to get all KB content, and store.getSettings().system_prompt for the base prompt
Use kb.buildSystemPrompt(store.getSettings().system_prompt, kb.listFiles(), store) to get the full compiled prompt
Cache using a simple Map<string, { systemPrompt: string, kbFiles: string[], cachedAt: number }> with Date.now() check
The KB instance has a file watcher — clear cache entry when files change (listen to kb events if available, or just use TTL)

userStories.title: Wire fnb-online-ordering system prompt to Rainbow AI KB
userStories.description: Modify getSystemPrompt() in fnb-online-ordering to optionally fetch the knowledge context from Rainbow AI's KB endpoint instead of reading local knowledge/ files. This enables hot-reloadable KB management through Rainbow AI's admin panel. Graceful fallback to local files if Rainbow AI is unreachable.
acceptanceCriteria: New env vars added to .env.example: RAINBOW_AI_URL (e.g. http://localhost:3002), RAINBOW_AI_ENABLED (true/false)
When RAINBOW_AI_ENABLED=true: getSystemPrompt() fetches KB context from RAINBOW_AI_URL/api/chat/makan-moments/kb-context
Response cached in memory with 5-minute TTL (same invalidation as current staticKnowledgeCache)
If Rainbow AI fetch fails (timeout, network error, non-200): falls back silently to local knowledge/ files with a console.warn
Fetch has a 3-second timeout to prevent blocking chat responses
When RAINBOW_AI_ENABLED is not set or false: behavior is identical to current (local files + DB menu)
The live menu from DB is ALWAYS fetched locally (not from Rainbow AI) — Rainbow AI only provides static KB context
Existing invalidateSystemPromptCache() also clears the Rainbow AI cache
technicalNotes: Edit src/lib/chat/system-prompt.ts
Add RAINBOW_AI_URL and RAINBOW_AI_ENABLED to .env.example with comments
Use native fetch() with AbortSignal.timeout(3000) for the request
The Rainbow AI response has { systemPrompt, kbFiles, cachedAt } — use systemPrompt as the static KB portion
Still build the full prompt locally: prepend settings.systemPromptPrefix, append the menu rules and tool instructions
The Rainbow AI KB replaces ONLY the static knowledge block (cafe-facts + faq), NOT the menu or tool instructions

userStories.title: Add time-aware proactive menu suggestions to system prompt
userStories.description: Enhance the AI waiter's system prompt to include the current time of day in Malaysia (UTC+8) and which menu categories are currently being served. The AI will naturally suggest time-appropriate items (breakfast in morning, lunch at noon, tea-time snacks in afternoon).
acceptanceCriteria: System prompt includes a TIME CONTEXT section with current Malaysia time (UTC+8) formatted as 'Current time: 2:30 PM (Tuesday)'
System prompt includes 'Currently serving: [category names]' based on time-slots.json configuration
Time context is computed fresh on every getSystemPrompt() call (not cached)
AI instructions updated: 'When a customer asks what to eat or for recommendations, prioritize items from the currently serving categories'
Works correctly regardless of server timezone (Vercel servers may be in any region)
technicalNotes: Edit src/lib/chat/system-prompt.ts
Read data/time-slots.json for time slot configuration (already used by src/lib/time-slots.ts)
Import getServingNowCategories or getDefaultCategoryForTime from src/lib/time-slots.ts if available
Use new Date().toLocaleString('en-MY', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur' }) for Malaysia time
Insert the time context section right before the knowledge block in the system prompt
Do NOT cache the time — it must be fresh on every call

userStories.title: Add suggested quick-reply buttons in chat
userStories.description: Add contextual quick-reply suggestion buttons below AI responses in the chat panel. Buttons let customers tap common queries instead of typing, improving mobile UX. Suggestions change based on conversation context.
acceptanceCriteria: Quick reply buttons appear below the last assistant message (not every message)
Initial suggestions (no conversation yet): 'What\'s popular?', 'Show me the menu', 'I want to order'
After ordering items: 'Check order status', 'Add more items', 'That\'s all'
After asking about menu: 'Any vegetarian options?', 'What\'s under RM15?', 'Recommend something'
Clicking a button sends that text as a user message
Buttons disappear when user starts typing or sends a message
Buttons are styled as pill-shaped, outlined, horizontally scrollable on mobile
Touch targets are at least 44px height per mobile-first design rules
No translations needed — quick replies are in English only (AI responds in user's language)
technicalNotes: Create src/components/chat/quick-replies.tsx as a client component
Integrate into chat-panel.tsx — render below the messages list, above the input
Determine context from the last few messages: if any contain 'tray' or 'order' keywords → show ordering suggestions
Use a simple keyword-based heuristic, not AI classification
Style with Tailwind: flex, gap-2, overflow-x-auto, whitespace-nowrap, rounded-full border, px-3 py-2
Use the append() function from useChat to send the quick reply as a user message

userStories.title: Render food photo cards when AI mentions menu items in chat
userStories.description: When the AI response mentions specific menu items (by code like BF01 or by name), render compact inline cards with the item photo, name, price, and an 'Add to Tray' button. Makes the chat visually engaging and lets customers add items directly from the conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: When AI response text contains a menu item code (e.g. BF01, SN03), a compact card renders inline below that response
Card shows: item thumbnail (from /images/menu/{code}.jpg), item name, price in RM, and 'Add' button
Clicking 'Add' calls addItem() from TrayContext to add 1 of that item
Maximum 3 cards per response (to avoid UI clutter)
Cards have rounded corners, subtle shadow, and match the earthy design system
If item image doesn't exist, card shows a placeholder bg-muted gradient
Cards are responsive: full width on mobile, inline on desktop
Menu data for matching is fetched once from /api/menu (or reuse existing menu data if available in context)
technicalNotes: Create src/components/chat/menu-item-card.tsx — renders a single compact menu item card
Modify src/components/chat/chat-bubble.tsx to detect item codes in assistant messages using regex /\b([A-Z]{2,3}\d{2,3})\b/g
Need a lightweight menu lookup — create a React context or use a simple fetch to /api/menu endpoint that returns items with code, name, price
The /api/menu endpoint may need to be created if it doesn't exist — a simple GET that returns menu_items from DB
Use next/image with the menu photo path pattern: /images/menu/{code}.jpg
For the 'Add' button, import useTrayActions from src/lib/tray-context.tsx
Cards should be wrapped in a flex container below the message text

userStories.title: Add thumbs up/down feedback on AI chat messages
userStories.description: Add subtle thumbs up/down feedback icons on assistant messages in the chat. Feedback is stored in the database for quality tracking. This gives the admin visibility into how well the AI waiter is performing.
acceptanceCriteria: Each assistant message in chat shows small thumbs up/down icons (only visible on hover on desktop, always visible on mobile)
Clicking thumbs up or down sends feedback to POST /api/chat/feedback
After clicking, the selected icon stays highlighted and both become disabled (one vote per message)
POST /api/chat/feedback accepts { messageIndex: number, rating: 'up' | 'down', sessionId?: string }
Feedback stored in a new chat_feedback table: id SERIAL, session_id TEXT, message_index INT, rating TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
The API creates the chat_feedback table if it doesn't exist (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS)
Brief 'Thanks!' text appears next to the icons after clicking, fading out after 2 seconds
technicalNotes: Modify src/components/chat/chat-bubble.tsx to add feedback icons to assistant messages
Create API route at src/app/api/chat/feedback/route.ts
Use Lucide icons: ThumbsUp, ThumbsDown (already available)
Track which messages have been rated using a Set<number> in chat-panel.tsx state
Use Neon Postgres (import sql from @/lib/db) for the feedback table
The chat_feedback table is separate from Rainbow AI's conversation_feedback — it's specific to the website chat

userStories.title: Add conversation logging from fnb chat to Rainbow AI
userStories.description: After each chat exchange, fire-and-forget POST the conversation data to Rainbow AI's existing webchat logging endpoint. This enables Rainbow AI to aggregate analytics across all channels (WhatsApp + website) and provides conversation memory for returning customers.
acceptanceCriteria: After each successful streamText() response, a fire-and-forget POST is sent to Rainbow AI's message endpoint
Only logs if RAINBOW_AI_ENABLED=true and RAINBOW_AI_URL is set
Logged data: user message, AI response text, session ID (from localStorage), response time
Logging failure does NOT affect the chat response (catch and console.warn only)
Session ID is generated once per browser session and persisted in localStorage key 'mm_chat_session'
Fetch timeout of 5 seconds on the logging request
technicalNotes: Modify src/app/api/chat/route.ts to add logging after the stream completes
The challenge is that streamText() returns a streaming response — we can't easily read the full AI response server-side
Alternative approach: log from the CLIENT side in chat-panel.tsx after receiving the full response
Client-side logging: POST to /api/chat/log which proxies to Rainbow AI's POST /api/chat/makan-moments/message
Create a thin proxy route at src/app/api/chat/log/route.ts that forwards to Rainbow AI
Rainbow AI's existing POST /api/chat/:profileId/message already persists to rainbow_messages table

userStories.title: Add Chat Analytics tab to admin dashboard
userStories.description: Add a new 'Chat Analytics' tab to the admin panel showing AI waiter performance metrics: total conversations, average response time, feedback scores, and popular questions. Reads from the local chat_feedback table and optionally from Rainbow AI analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: New 'Chat Analytics' tab appears in admin panel (after Settings tab)
Shows total chat feedback count (thumbs up vs thumbs down) with percentage
Shows a simple table of recent feedback entries (last 50) with date, message index, and rating
If no feedback data exists yet, shows a friendly empty state: 'No chat feedback collected yet'
Tab is lazy-loaded using next/dynamic (consistent with other admin tabs)
Only accessible to authenticated admin users (same auth as other admin tabs)
technicalNotes: Create src/components/admin/chat-analytics-panel.tsx (client component)
Create API route at src/app/api/admin/chat-analytics/route.ts (requires auth via verifyAdminToken)
Query chat_feedback table: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) GROUP BY rating; and SELECT * ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
Register the new tab in the admin tabs array (likely in src/app/admin/page.tsx or admin-tabs component)
Keep it simple — no charts library needed, just use Tailwind-styled cards and a table
Handle case where chat_feedback table doesn't exist yet (catch SQL error, return empty data)

userStories.title: Add conversation session persistence and recovery
userStories.description: Persist the chat session ID in localStorage so returning customers can continue their conversation. On chat widget open, check for an existing session and display a 'Welcome back' message. This makes the AI waiter feel more personal and continuous.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat session ID stored in localStorage under key 'mm_chat_session_id'
Session ID generated on first chat open and reused across page navigations
When chat widget opens with an existing session, show a subtle 'Welcome back! How can I help you today?' message
Session expires after 24 hours (check timestamp stored alongside session ID)
If session is expired, generate a new one and start fresh
Conversation history from useChat() is preserved during single page session (already works via useChat state)
Clear session when customer explicitly types 'new chat' or 'start over'
technicalNotes: Modify src/components/chat/chat-panel.tsx to manage session persistence
Store { sessionId: string, createdAt: number } in localStorage
On mount: check localStorage, validate age < 24h, set sessionId in useChat config or pass to API
The sessionId is already accepted by /api/chat but not persisted client-side — this story adds persistence
For 'Welcome back' message, inject it as an initial assistant message in the messages array
For 'new chat' / 'start over' detection: check user message text before sending to API
